name: senlindesign/claude2figma
description: A small Claude-to-Figma workflow skill set with exactly 4 skills: Figma preflight checks, component rules, Figma style binding, and reference interpretation. It guides an agent to work from a Figma file with a design system, checking style and variable bindings on returned nodes.
install: Clone-and-copy: clone the repo, copy .claude/skills/* into the project .claude/skills/, copy .claude/settings.json, copy CLAUDE.md.template to CLAUDE.md, then paste the Figma file URL into CLAUDE.md. Use the current repo name in the clone step; README step 1 still shows the old repo name (cc2figma), and GitHub renames normally redirect, but the draft uses the current name.
